name: Tokyo Marriott Hotel
accessSummary: Kitashinagawa Station (Keikyu Line): about 7 min walk / Shinagawa Station (JR & Keikyu Lines) Takanawa Exit: about 12 min walk / Osaki Station (JR): about 15 min walk / Gotanda Station (JR): about 16 min walk

rooms.name: The GOTENYAMA Ballroom (entire)
rooms.note: B1F. Large banquet hall. Wedding banquet: 400. 22.8 m long x 37.8 m wide.

rooms.name: Iris/Camellia (entire)
rooms.note: B1F. Medium banquet hall. 10.3 m long x 31.0 m wide. Reception capacity is 90 on the other official site (marriott.com).

rooms.name: The Garden View
rooms.note: B1F. Medium banquet hall. Wedding banquet: 60. Reception capacity is 60 on marriott.com.

rooms.name: Oak
rooms.note: B1F. Small banquet room. Reception capacity is listed as "-" on marriott.com.

rooms.name: Studio
rooms.note: 1F. Can be divided into 3, with a maximum of 49 people per room. Wedding banquet: 110. 17.2 m long x 11.8 m wide. marriott.com lists theater 220, school 100, reception 110 and seated 120.

ops.parking: About 70 spaces on B3F. Height limit 2.1 m. Visitors pay 500 yen per 30 minutes. Banquet and wedding guests park free for up to 4 hours. Hotel guests pay 2,000 yen per night.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has Lounge & Dining G (daily 6:30-23:00) and the Pastry & Bakery GGCo. cafe (daily 10:00-20:00). There are also 3 private rooms.
